addr: No.32, 32nd Cross Rd, near Coffee Day, 7th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560070, India

rev.t: Bobby and team are excellent, I have bought 18 cars myself as I dont go for new cars in the last 30 years, I not only have options of buying what color, number and car I want, but I also get to sell it at very good price with their help …

We have bought almost 6 cars from Jayanagar Autos. If you are looking to buy an used car..this is the best place for you. Best value for money. They tell you everything about the car including the problems if any . I am completely satisfied with the car we have bought from them! Thanks Vinod sir...

Babu is amazing. We got our swift from them. Even though we requested for few changes with the vehicle after trying 5-6 cars and this particular swift for 3 times, they were very patient and fixed everything we asked for before handing over. Well maintained cars. Babu made things easy for us.
